Module.protocol: The `ModuleProtocol` class for resolving, reading and loading modules. See [Protocols](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-module#protocols) for usage.
cache: A cache of loaded modules for this module. Defaults to `Module.cache`.
Module.resolve: Resolve the module `specifier` relative to the `parentURL`. `specifier` is a string and `parentURL` is a WHATWG `URL`.
Module.load: Load a module with the provided `url`. `url` is a WHATWG `URL`. If provided, the `source` will be passed to the matching `extension` for the `url`.
Module.createRequire: Create a preconfigured `require()` bound to `parentURL`, so specifiers resolve and load relative to it.
url: The WHATWG `URL` identifier of the module.
type: The type of the module. See `Module.constants.types` for possible values.
defaultType: The assumed type of a module without a `type` using an ambiguous extension, such as `.js`. See `Module.constants.types` for possible values.
main: The module representing the entry script where the program was launched.
imports: The import map when the module was loaded.
resolutions: A map of preresolved imports with keys being serialized parent URLs and values being `"imports"` maps.
builtins: A map of builtin module specifiers mapped to the loaded module.
conditions: An array of conditions used to resolve dependencies while loading the module. See [Conditional exports](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-module#conditional-exports) for possible values.
ModuleProtocol: Defines how modules are resolved, read and loaded; custom protocols can serve modules from outside the file system, such as a `Hyperdrive` or a `bare-bundle`.
ModuleProtocol.resolve: Resolve a module `URL` to the `URL` that should be linked. The default implementation returns `url` unchanged.
ModuleProtocol.read: Return the source code of a URL, represented as a string or buffer.
ModuleProtocol.extend: Create a new protocol that uses this protocol as its context, overriding the given `methods`.
ModuleProtocol.isProtocol: Return whether `value` is a protocol of the same version as this one, whichever copy of `bare-module` created it.
Attributes: Import attributes instructing how a module should be loaded.
Attributes.type: How the module should be loaded: one of `'script'`, `'module'`, `'json'`, `'bundle'`, `'addon'`, `'binary'`, or `'text'`.
Cache: A map of module URL `href`s to loaded modules.
Require: The function returned by `Module.createRequire()`: resolves and loads modules relative to its parent URL, with `main`, `cache`, `resolve`, `addon`, and `asset` attached.
Require.resolve: Use the internal machinery of `require()` to resolve `specifier` relative to `parentURL` and return the path string.
Require.addon: Import an addon module; `specifier` is resolved relative to `parentURL` using the addon resolution algorithm.
Require.asset: Resolve `specifier` relative to `parentURL` and return the path of the asset as a string.
RequireOptions: Options for `require()`; `with` holds the import attributes.
RequireAddon: The `require.addon` function: imports addon modules, with `host` and `resolve` attached.
RequireAddon.host: The platform and architecture used when resolving addons, following the pattern `<platform>-<arch>[-<environment>]`.
RequireAddon.resolve: Resolve `specifier` relative to `parentURL` as an addon and return the path string.
